nom: COSRX One Step Original Blemish Pore Clear Pad

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin describe the pads as helpful for controlling shine and removing excess oil from the pores, and for keeping breakouts more in check, though one saw no visible reduction in pore size despite smoother-feeling skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: one with extremely dry, irritation-prone skin calls the pads a perfect daily exfoliator, while another with an already-compromised barrier finds them harsh and drying when applied to the face.
segments.combination: The one reviewer identifying combination, sensitive skin used the pads as a once-weekly exfoliant and saw a stubborn, dermatitis-related pimple clear quickly without any dryness.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin most often describe the pads as gentle and non-irritating, including several with rosacea or a history of reacting to acne products who report no new redness or breakouts, though a couple mention redness on the cheeks or a harsh, drying effect when their skin was already compromised.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several with dry or sensitive skin, say the pads do not strip or dry out the skin and can even feel hydrating; one reviewer with an already-compromised, very dry barrier found them harsh and drying when used on the face.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or reactive skin generally report no new redness, with one saying her skin looked less red and bumpy after use; one reviewer with sensitive skin, however, notes the pads bring up redness on her cheeks, which limits her to using them two to three times a week.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer describes her skin barrier as already compromised and finds the pads too harsh when used on the face in that state, getting on better applying them along the jawline and shoulders instead; reviewers without a pre-existing barrier issue describe the pads as balancing rather than stripping.
concerns.spots: A couple of reviewers report their skin tone looking more even within one to two weeks of use, and one describes her acne scarring beginning to fade alongside her active blemishes.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers report fewer breakouts, from hormonal acne to body and bikini-area blemishes, with some describing near-complete clearing within about a week; a few report only partial improvement, including one who still gets some acne though less painfully than before, and one whose allergy-prone skin did not tolerate the product well.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the pads help control oil and shine and pull excess dirt and oil out of the pores, though one notes no visible reduction in pore size despite the smoother feel.

aspects.libelle: Textured side for exfoliation, smooth side for a gentler pass
Pads feel thin, may need two per use
Pads generously soaked, good value per container

extraits.titre: Comparable to Medicube Zero Pore Pad
extraits.texte: I'm basically comparing this to the Medicube Zero pad. These pads are bigger with more pads in the jar, tightly packed with the lid go keep them from drying up. I like the tweezers for hygienic purposes when taking each pad out like Medicube but I prefer Medicube's as it's easier to handle. It doesn't sting my face but I do have sensitive skin, so I can only use it 2-3 times a week as it can cause some redness on my cheeks. I'm not a fan of the strong herbal scent (tea tree oil?) but it did leave my skin glowing.

extraits.titre: Effective but drying for already dry skin
extraits.texte: I am finding this a little harsh for my very dry and sensitive skin. My skin barrier is currently a little wrecked and not tolerating many things. Using it more along the jaw line and upper shoulders has been working better for me than my face. The packaging is great and the product is huge, much bigger than the picture led me to think.

I love the idea of this product. I have oily skin and hate how dirty my pores always look. Unfortunately, I have a lot of skin allergies and this product is not hypoallergenic and fragrance free like so many of the CosRX products are. I would love if CosRX came out with an aha/bha product for sensitive skin.
I have extremely sensitive, dry skin that is very prone to irritation and ingrown hairs. This product has been a perfect daily exfoliator for my problem areas!

I rarely break out but when I do, it is difficult to get it under control because my skin reacts to so many products. These blemish pads have been AMAZING!! First off, there are tweezers inside the lid so it makes grabbing them easy and I'm not touching all over multiple pads which rocks. There is a textured side and a smooth side to each pad. I used the textured side on the areas that had blemishes and the smooth side on the rest of my face and neck. I had like 8 pimple patches on my face at one point but after using these pads for 5 mornings and evenings in a row after washing my face with the Cosrx snail mucin gel cleanser, my skin is almost completely clear! No irritation, no break outs, no new redness (I do have rosacea), no painful dryness, it's actually very impressive!!

I am really loving this new product! I have very sensitive skin that reacts badly to many ingredients, it makes it difficult to achieve that smooth, beautiful, glass skin we all want. THIS product has helped give me that gift. It is working perfectly for me. No break outs, no skin irritation + easy to use after i wash my face. It smells nice, feels nice when applied+ gives a fresh shiny appearance after use. I really do love this stuff + am happily using it each am/pm with noticeable results. Thank you Cosrx, you've made my 46yr old skin very pleased!

I have not used toner pads in many years but I have, obviously, been missing out! I have combination sensitive skin so I used the pads as a once weekly exfoliant and I was so happy to see this random dermatitis pimple go down so quickly. These pads are great for breakouts, they aren't drying and they fit perfecting into my regimen.
